verdict.rationale: ClickHouse describes itself as an open-source DBMS. It documents running on your own machine as a single binary via a curl install script, and its CLI can launch and manage local servers. Community users report running it on their own hardware in production, from single desktops to multi-node clusters built with official Docker images. missing for 10: first-party production-grade self-hosted cluster deployment docs in the pack (the install doc is framed around build/test/experiment), and a noted gap running in unprivileged containers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
